title: Understanding the Power of Compounding via SIPs
summary: How consistent monthly investments harness compounding over long-term market cycles.

sections.heading: Why Consistency Outperforms Market Timing
sections.body: Systematic Investment Plans (SIP) eliminate emotional decision-making by averaging purchase costs across bull and bear phases.

sections.heading: The Horizon Effect
sections.body: Compounding displays exponential growth primarily during later years. Starting early gives capital the luxury of time.

title: Why Adequate Health Insurance Must Precede Equity Investments
summary: Medical inflation can erode years of portfolio gains if healthcare risks remain unhedged.

sections.heading: Protecting Capital Against Catastrophic Outflows
sections.body: An unexpected hospitalization without adequate cover forces premature redemption of long-term investments.
